StoryboardSession.meaning: Operator-facing editing session over one canonical storyboard and one preparation graph. This is a mapping concept, not a new persistent CAE type.

StoryboardRevision.meaning: Immutable revision snapshot of storyboard preparation parameters.

adopted_behaviors.behavior: Aggregate preparation readiness from shot basics, semantic defaults, action beats, asset/dialogue candidate state, and explicit ready status; permit linking an existing reusable asset during preparation.
adopted_behaviors.cae_mapping: Derived read model over EditorialStoryboardRecord + eligible evidence/assets + PreparationGraphRecord; asset links remain downstream of CAE authority.
adopted_behaviors.state_change: No Jellyfish state table is adopted; any CAE state change must route through existing operator/program authorities.

adopted_behaviors.behavior: Refresh extracted candidates while preserving already-linked selections, and support explicit linked/pending/ignored outcomes.
adopted_behaviors.cae_mapping: Use existing ContentCandidateRecord lineage plus EditorialDecisionReceiptRecord; rejected or superseded candidates remain inspectable.

adopted_behaviors.behavior: Resolve reusable character/scene/prop/costume assets, validate entity existence, synchronize linked state, and present deterministically sorted linked assets.
adopted_behaviors.cae_mapping: Reference/presentation behavior only; do not create a Jellyfish project-asset store. CAE asset/evidence authority controls eligibility, provenance, rights and promotion.

adopted_behaviors.behavior: Separate shot identity, linked character context, extracted candidates, frame references, and dialogue context.
adopted_behaviors.cae_mapping: Presentation decomposition only. CAE semantic truth remains in EditorialStoryboardRecord/SemanticProgram and evidence lineage; frame/media references are governed production inputs.

adopted_behaviors.behavior: Expose explicit extraction lifecycle states instead of collapsing missing, empty, pending and resolved into one boolean.
adopted_behaviors.cae_mapping: Adopt as a derived inspection taxonomy. It does not authorize CAE promotion.

edit.receipt: existing operator receipt surface where a governed decision is made
edit.recovery: reload latest revision and create a new revision from that base

candidate_review.postcondition: canonical candidate state changes only through existing CAE API/store paths
candidate_review.recovery: retain rejected candidate and issue a new governed decision

visual_inspection.postcondition: inspection may inform an operator decision but cannot by itself promote semantic correctness
visual_inspection.receipt: operator decision receipt when a decision is recorded
visual_inspection.recovery: repair, reject, or request another candidate/reference

anti_centroid.good_looking_but_wrong: A visually coherent shot preview uses an aesthetically matching generated frame that is not tied to the approved evidence/asset lineage. The preview looks correct but must remain ineligible because visual quality cannot manufacture source authority.
anti_centroid.expected_result: presentation is allowed for inspection; promotion remains blocked until provenance, semantic constraints and operator approval are satisfied.

excluded_behavior: Jellyfish database schema and project/task authority model
Jellyfish frontend UI state as a source of truth
